what_it_does: Extends ChatPORT (a code translation system) to translate GPU programs from CUDA (NVIDIA's parallel computing framework) to SYCL (an open-standard parallel framework). Translating between these languages is manually tedious and error-prone. The work fine-tunes 19 open-source language models ranging from 500 million to 34 billion parameters on pairs of equivalent CUDA and SYCL kernels. Kernels are small programs that run on accelerators. This enables automated conversion of GPU code across vendor-neutral platforms.
